rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The list moves from fewer to more: circumambulation is limited to the Kaaba, retreat to mosques, prayer to any pure ground, and prostration is more numerous than bowing.
rows.anchor: فالطائفون أقل من العاكفين لأن الطواف لا يكون إلا حول الكعبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The progression suits the Sacred House: circumambulators are closest to it, followed by those in mosques and worshippers who face it in prayer everywhere.
rows.anchor: ولهذا التدرج سبب اقتضاه المقام فإن الكلام على بيت الله الحرام

words: ارْكَعُوا وَاسْجُدُوا وَاعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَافْعَلُوا الْخَيْرَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here the order rises from bowing, the least extensive act, to prostration, broader worship of God, and finally doing good.
rows.anchor: بدأ بالركوع وهو أقل المذكورات ثم السجود وهو أكثر ثم عبادة الرب وهي أعمّ ثم فعل الخير

words: اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The order can also descend from the broad act of devotion, to the narrower prostration, and then to the more restricted bowing.
rows.anchor: فبدأ بالقنوت وهو عموم العبادة ثم السجود وهو أخص وأقل ثم الركوع وهو أقل وأخص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qur'anic expression is deliberate: every word and letter is intentionally placed.
rows.anchor: القرآن هو تعبير بياني مقصود أي أن كل كلمة وكل حرف فيه وُضع وضعاً مقصوداً

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In Luqman 31:33, omitting an understood فيه after the day makes recompense unrestricted to that day, since its effects continue afterward; the Qur'an similarly omits فيه when mentioning recompense.
rows.anchor: الحذف يفيد الإطلاق ولا يختص بذلك اليوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase فيه is stated in 2:281 because the return and recompense described there are confined to the Day of Judgment.
rows.anchor: ذكر (فيه) لأنه منحصر فقط في يوم الحساب وليس عموماً

words: يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصَارُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase فيه is included because this day is specifically the Day of Resurrection and reckoning.
rows.anchor: اليوم منحصر في يوم القيامة والحساب لذا ذكر (فيه)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qur'anic word order is deliberate: no word is advanced without a contextual purpose, and the whole expression is considered together.
rows.anchor: لم يقدم لفظة على لفظة إلا لغرض يقتضيه السياق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The grandeur and height of Qur'anic expression show that such composition is beyond human capacity.
rows.anchor: مثل هذا النظم لا يمكن أن يكون في طوق بشر فسبحان الله رب العالمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Across the Qur'an play normally precedes amusement; this verse uniquely puts amusement before play.
rows.anchor: كل الآيات في القرآن جاء اللعب مقدّماً على اللهو إلا في هذه الآية من سورة العنكبوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preceding verse discusses God's provision, which is associated with distraction and amusement rather than play; 63:9 likewise warns that wealth and children can distract from God's remembrance.
rows.anchor: والرزق ليس من مدعاة اللعب وإنما اللهو كما في قوله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author notes a different placement of شهيداً: 29:52 places it after بيني وبينكم, while 17:96 puts it before that phrase.
rows.anchor: كفى بالله بيني وبينكم شهيداً

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: من is used for masculine and feminine, singular and plural; Arabic and Qur'anic usage commonly first treats it as masculine singular, then resumes it according to its intended sense.
rows.anchor: يأتي أول مرة بـ (من) بصيغة المفرد المذكر ثم يعقبه ما يوضح المعنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the address to the Prophet's wives, من يأت منكن follows the masculine-singular default, and the following forms clarify its feminine plural sense.
rows.anchor: الآية موضع السؤال (من يأت منكن) تدخل في هذه القاعدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An exception shifts from singular for those who look to plural for those who listen, because listeners are more numerous.
rows.anchor: جاء في الأولى بالإفراد والثانية جمع لماذا؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surrounding passage concerns creation and God's blessings, not monotheism; creation is foregrounded accordingly, with each expression placed to fit its context.
rows.anchor: فقدم الخلق لذلك فوضع كل تعبير في موطنه اللائق حسب السياق

rows.speaker: الكرماني
rows.claim: Al-Kirmani says 6:102 first rejects the previously mentioned partners, while Ghafir 40:62 leads with creation because the passage has just argued from the creation of the heavens, earth, and people.
rows.anchor: جاء في البرهان للكرماني قوله (ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author gives another word-order contrast: one verse places wealth and lives before في سبيل الله, while the other puts that phrase first.
rows.anchor: وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A broken plural permits masculine or feminine agreement; the author says feminine agreement is chosen when the group is more numerous and masculine when it is smaller.
rows.anchor: جمع التكسير يجوز تذكيره وتأنيثه. يؤنّث الفعل عندما يكون الفاعل أكثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The small retinue of the governor's wife is described with masculine وقال in وقال نسوة.
rows.anchor: ونسوة هن حاشية امرأة العزيز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The feminine قالت with الأعراب reflects the group's great number.
rows.anchor: استخدم الفعل قالت مؤنثاً لأن الأعراب كُثُر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine agreement in جاءكم رسل is used for the smaller group of messengers mentioned there.
rows.anchor: هؤلاء مجموعة من الرسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The feminine جاءَتْ with the messengers in 7:53 refers to all the messengers, more than the group in 3:183.
rows.anchor: المذكورون هم جميع الرسل وهم أكثر من الأولى لذا جاء الفعل مؤنثاً

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أجمع is used for the abstract matter, whereas جمع also applies to concrete things; the coordinated phrase therefore implies جمعوا before شركاءكم: gather your allies.
rows.anchor: فالمقصود في الآية أجمعوا أمرهم وجمعوا شركاءهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In تبوؤوا الدار والإيمان, settling applies to the abode but not faith, so coordination implies a different omitted governing verb for faith, as in the saying about drinking milk and eating dates.
rows.anchor: الإيمان لا يتبؤأ إنما يتبوأ الدار فهنا عطف على الدار لكن ليس بنفس المعنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The construction ألا يعلم من خلق can mean either that the Creator knows His servants and their secrets, or that He knows those He created; both readings are intended.
rows.anchor: إذن (من خلق) تحتمل المعنيين الخالق والمخلوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قرض can mean lending or money, so قرضاً حسناً is both a sincere act of lending to God and good, lawful wealth; the two senses are intended.
rows.anchor: إذن القرض في الآية تحتمل المعنيين، فلو كان القصد الإقراض لكان إعرابها مفعول مطلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The triliteral verbal noun ضلال is used after the quadriliteral verb أضل because Satan begins the deviation and the person continues it; using إضلال would assign the whole process to Satan alone.
rows.anchor: الشيطان يبدأ بالضلال والإنسان يُكمل ما بدأه الشيطان ويبتدع من طرق الضلال ما يبتدع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The narrow example concerning Abraham's conduct, with an exception for his statement to his father, uses feminine كانت and قد; the more general model for those hoping in God and the Last Day uses masculine كان and emphatic لقد.
rows.anchor: عندما اتسعت العبادة وصارت أعمّ وأوسع من الأولى ذكّر وجاء باللام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For broken plurals such as نسوة and الأعراب, Arabic grammar permits either masculine or feminine agreement; the author cites قالت نسوة and قالت الأعراب.
rows.anchor: يمكن أن يؤنّث الفعل أو يُذكّر إذا كان الجمع جمع تكسير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an uses masculine فسجد with the angels in one passage and feminine فنادت with them in another; the author says expressive patterns determine the choice.
rows.anchor: في سورة ص (فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ {73} ) وجاءت الملائكة هنا بالتذكير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every command addressed to the angels in the Qur'an is masculine, as in اسجدوا, أنبئوني, and فقعوا له ساجدين.
rows.anchor: كل فعل أمر يصدر إلى الملائكة يكون بالتذكير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author also says verbs following mention of the angels are masculine, citing their entering through every gate and glorifying their Lord.
rows.anchor: كل فعل يقع بعد ذكر الملائكة يأتي بالتذكير أيضاً

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In praise or blame, القطع intensifies the judgment: praise is stronger when a virtue is publicly known, and blame is stronger when the fault is notorious.
rows.anchor: فإذا كان المدح بالقطع يكون أمدح للشخص بمعنى أنه بلغ من الخصال الكريمة ما لا يخفى على أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Lahab's wife is disparaged twice: القطع marks a known quality, and the intensive form حمالة heightens blame for the harm she caused the Prophet.
rows.anchor: ذمّ الله تعالى امرأة أبو لهب مرتين مرة بالقطع لأن الكل يعلم بصفاتها

rows.speaker: بعض النحاة
rows.claim: Some grammarians parse حمالة as the predicate of the subject امرأته.
rows.anchor: وقد أعرب بعض النحاة كلمة (حمّالة) على أنها خبر لمبتدأ (امرأته)

rows.speaker: آخرون
rows.claim: Other grammarians treat حمالة الحطب as an adjective, but the author rejects this because it is an indefinite لفظية annexation and cannot modify the definite امرأته.
rows.anchor: ولآخرون أعربوها على أنها صفه وهذا عليه اعتراض ظاهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إضافة لفظية attaches participles denoting present or future to their complements, and attaches adjectives and intensive forms without restricting their time.
rows.anchor: والإضافة اللفظية هي إضاقة اسم الفاعل واسم المفعول إذا كانا دالّين على الحال أو الإستقبال إلى معمولهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His examples show لفظية phrases remaining indefinite with an indefinite noun and becoming definite with a definite noun, which is why حمالة الحطب cannot modify امرأته.
rows.anchor: أقبل رجلٌ مصري المولد (مصري المولد إضافة لفظية وبقيت نكرة)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author parses حمالة الحطب as the direct object of an omitted verb, تقديره أذمّها.
rows.anchor: مفعول به لفعل محذوف تقديره أذّمّها
